title: Canonical screened literature cards
description: Makes paper_cards.jsonl the authoritative screened literature set and requires the master Agent to consolidate delegated retrieval before completing synthesis.
changes: Distinguished retrieval acceptance from Agent screening.
Required master-Agent consolidation of subagent retrieval results.
Prohibited declaring literature review complete without non-empty paper cards.
Aligned chat summaries, literature reports, the right panel, and later bibliography generation to one canonical set.

rollback.notes: Restore dialogue checkpoints without canonical paper-card completion rules.
